title: T2I-Adapter bank to shared adapter basis
hypothesis: A shared rank-2 adapter function basis with per-condition codes preserves heldout control and pairwise composition while saving at least 25% complete serialized bytes over independent full adapters and improves on independent rank-2 adapters.
mirror_coordinate: per-condition low-dimensional code addressing a shared adapter basis
logical_multiplicity: 12 plug-and-play guidance adapters and their pairwise sums
controls: native shared PCA basis plus condition coefficients

development.selection_metric: heldout condition operator nRMSE, composition nRMSE, actual complete payload bytes

fresh.reason: no audit opened; assess development gate and native factorization attribution first

success_gate: Heldout and pairwise composition nRMSE <=0.02; >=25% complete byte saving vs independent full adapters; strict quality-byte-compute improvement over independent rank-2 and native shared PCA controls.
failure_gate: Quality/byte gate miss or exact native shared-basis/PCA function and payload alias is FAIL for Mirror-specific value.
amendments: A01 before final scoring: corrected the heldout calibration design-matrix axis order and made active MACs count all individual and pair-composition requests consistently. The initial erroneous run is preserved in RESULTS_INITIAL_BUGGY.csv and excluded from final metrics; no protocol thresholds or seed changed.
boundaries: Synthetic adapter matrices only; no trained T2I-Adapter, frozen diffusion backbone or generated image metric.
Shared basis is estimated from training condition matrices; heldout codes use eight calibration examples per condition.
No near-convergence capacity or accelerator runtime claim.
